peg.peg_mechanism_score_basis: MEASURES THE MECHANISM'S MATURITY, NOT TODAY'S DEVIATION. A two-token synthetic dollar whose peg is underwritten by GATED KYC ARBITRAGE rather than by open liquidity — so a retail holder cannot perform the arbitrage that defends it. Coherent in design but YOUNG AND UNTESTED THROUGH A STRESS EVENT, and realised yield runs below its own target band. A live band showing par says the mechanism has not been tested; this scores whether it would hold when it is.

backing.backing_score_basis: MEASURES BACKING QUALITY AND OBSERVABILITY, not the live coverage ratio. ⚠️ Roughly 57% of supply is backed by assets NOT OBSERVABLE ON-CHAIN, disclosed only through the issuer's own transparency page — so a live ratio is a report, not a reading. Cut in August on the FIFTH ESCALATING WITHDRAWAL in a 2,200-row series: judged as a TREND across discrete one-hour drops, not as a snapshot.

liquidity.liquidity_score_basis: MEASURES EXECUTABLE DEPTH AGAINST SUPPLY, not headline TVL. The real venue is a single ~$4.75M pool against ~$136M supply, and DEPTH-PER-DOLLAR FELL as supply grew 27.6% over five weeks while that venue did not. A depth figure rising with supply is not improving liquidity.
liquidity.liquidity_score_persistence: filtered — depth relative to supply, not absolute depth

issuer.issuer_score_basis: MEASURES THE ENTITY AND ITS LEGAL WRAPPER, AND THE TWO POINT IN OPPOSITE DIRECTIONS. ✅ UP: an elite partner stack and a credentialed ex-Optiver/IMC team — ⚠️ AND THAT CREDENTIAL IS SCORED AS RELEVANT HERE SPECIFICALLY BECAUSE thUSD RUNS AN ACTIVE BASIS TRADE, which is what those operators do. It is worth A HALF POINT ABOVE thBILL, whose passive wrapper does not need that skill — the same team is not worth the same premium on a different instrument. ⚠️ DOWN, AND IT IS STRUCTURAL: an UNLICENSED, NON-BANKRUPTCY-REMOTE PANAMA ISSUER plus material off-chain disclosure gaps. ⚠️ NON-BANKRUPTCY-REMOTE IS THE LOAD-BEARING HALF — it means holder claims are not ring-fenced from the operating entity, so operator skill and holder protection are independent questions and only the first is strong.

dependencies.underlying_score_basis: MEASURES THE COUNTERPARTY SET. Backing 2.5 already prices the withdrawals and the PoR gap; neither is re-charged here. ⚠️ TWO BRANCHES, BOTH LONG: 62.30% thUSD -> thBILL -> tULTRA -> Standard Chartered Libeara -> Treasuries, and 37.70% thUSD -> gold-carry -> FundBridge custody + CME futures (~$51.3M). ⚠️⚠️ AND IT IS RECURSIVE: thBILL IS 62.30% OF thUSD WHILE thUSD HOLDS 96.34% OF ALL thBILL. Each is simultaneously the other's largest asset and largest holder, so neither can be assessed independently and stress propagates between them BY CONSTRUCTION rather than by contagion. ✅ THE PARTNER ROSTER IS GENUINELY STRONG — Standard Chartered, Wellington as T-Bill sub-advisor, FundBridge with a 20% first-loss buffer, SIG, CME — AND SPEC §0 SAYS DO NOT CREDIT THAT HERE: a good counterparty at 100% is still 100%. ⚠️ WHAT IT DOES SCORE IS THAT EVERYTHING ROUTES THROUGH ONE OPERATOR WITH NO SUBSTITUTE: Theo Network, Panama-domiciled, UNLICENSED ANYWHERE, NOT BANKRUPTCY-REMOTE. Holding thUSD is a contractual claim on Theo, so the institutional names sit BEHIND a wrapper giving a holder no ring-fenced claim on any of them. ⚠️ 37.70% OF THE BOOK HAS NO PROOF OF RESERVES, and off_chain_backing_implied_usd is computed as supply minus on-chain reserves, so IT CAN NEVER FALL and cannot distinguish 'deployed' from 'gone' — a definition, not an observation. ⚠️⚠️ AND A SINGLE UNNAMED PARTY MARKS THE ENTIRE BOOK: the sthUSD share price blends on-chain thBILL NAV, the off-chain CME futures mark, gold spot and lending interest, and whoever publishes that oracle is UNDISCLOSED. A counterparty you cannot name is one you cannot assess, and this one sets the price of everything. That is the factor arguing for 2.5; held at 3.0 because the rest of the set is named, institutional and enumerable, which susdat 2.5 is not.
